tagline: Every skill and MCP server your coding agents load, in one field
brief: A local control plane for the skills (and soon MCP servers) that AI coding agents load. For developers running 2-4 agents who need to see what each one has, spot what drifted and fix it safely. It should feel like a calm, exact instrument.
criteria: Readable at 16 px, works in one colour, light and dark first-class, distinct from AI dev-tool cliches (sparkles, gradients, node networks, hexagons).

concepts.name: Quiet soft J
concepts.idea: A 3x3 field of jacks: the cells that spell J are lit, and the blue one is the jack being patched in.
rationale: Mirrors the product's own skills x agents table, with the active cells lit
Reads as a J at every size; below 24 px the grey cells fade and it becomes the small cut automatically
Every cell edge sits on a whole pixel at 16 px; one radius (8) plus one soft radius (40)

recommendation: Quiet soft J: the field tells the product story, the J carries the name.
next_steps: Swap the web UI favicon, header mark and README logo
